titles: Hannibal: The Man Who Nearly Destroyed Rome
Outnumbered Almost 2 to 1: How Hannibal Destroyed a Roman Army
Hannibal vs Rome: The Whole War in Maps
hook: In 216 BC, Rome sent the largest army it had ever fielded to destroy one man. By sunset it was gone. This is the full story of Hannibal Barca: the oath, the march over the Alps, Trebia, Trasimene, Cannae, fifteen years in Italy, and the final battle at Zama — told with animated maps and the ancient sources on screen.
